runs.t: Static analysis inspects source or compiled representations without executing full application behavior. It includes type checking, lint rules, data-flow checks and security analyzers.

Automate rules in CI, distinguish correctness from style, and prioritize high-signal checks. Architecture linting can enforce dependency boundaries; taint analysis can detect suspicious flows from untrusted input to dangerous sinks.
A TypeScript monorepo can reject cross-module imports and unsafe type assertions before tests run, while a security analyzer flags raw SQL composition with user input.
Static analysis has false positives and blind spots for runtime state and business logic. Do not silence warnings globally to keep a build green; document justified exceptions narrowly.
